exactMessage: E5: grafo ocupado; abortar transacción completa, sin espera global
cause: BEFORE STATEMENT trigger e5_serialize on usuarios UPDATE calls pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(650005,5); concurrent login transactions collide even under READ COMMITTED. The trigger explicitly raises 40001 rather than waiting behind locks already held by callers.
scope: Fresh disposable reproduction; original historical nested error unavailable. Identical failing route/UPDATE reproduced, not a claim that the lost original cause was recovered.
proposedNarrowFix: Acquire the same transaction-level E5 graph lock as the first login transaction statement, before session insert/FK/user locks. Preserve atomic session/last-access/audit, no write retry and no trigger change.
